mintAuthority.summary: USDA's BSC token has an uncapped MINT role. At BSC block 125055866, the previously recorded minter contract and EOA still hold MINT; the EOA still holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can appoint minters. The minter contract retains its separate EOA owner. Exhaustive current role-holder enumeration was not repeated, so no claim of a sole administrator or exactly two minters is made. Address ownership, key custody, and the unverified minter contract's downstream policy remain undisclosed.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed mint roles 2026-07-26 at BSC block 112274230; upgrade-authority follow-up 2026-07-28 at BSC block 112516717 (block hash 0xbf16acf314e97d9600a2d69586b86b8a0e018351754e8b623d4cc9ebe68e1e29) via fixed-block BSC RPC. The verified USDA source (contract USDAWithPremium, BscScan exact match; Sourcify full_match runtime+creation) defines MINT as keccak256('MINT') / 0xfdf81848136595c31bb5f76217767372bc4bf906663038eb38381131ea27ecba, gates mint(address,uint256) with onlyVault (hasRole MINT) and no maximum-supply check, and sets DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as MINT's admin. Fixed-block hasRole still confirms MINT for 0x56f237297306220ebc062b7c0348418c9cdccbdb and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for 0x14170c3332ccd96859c8fb5754a753e476d09751. Upgradeability resolution: (1) creation tx 0x2af6b226… has empty to and deploys contractAddress 0x17eafd08… at block 56765216 (direct CREATE, not a proxy factory call); (2) at block 112516717 EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots on the token are all zero and runtime code is 17,338 bytes; (3) verified source and ABI contain mint/AccessControl/tax/blacklist surfaces but no upgradeTo, upgradeToAndCall, proxiableUUID, implementation, diamondCut, beacon, or delegatecall upgrade path; (4) independent Sourcify proxyResolution reports isProxy=false with empty implementations. Therefore mint-critical token bytecode is non-upgradeable (model=immutable, canChangeMintLogic=false). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can still grant MINT to new callers; that is authority concentration, not implementation upgrade. The MINT-role minter contract 0x56f237… remains source-unverified (4,314 bytes) with zero EIP-1967 slots, but does not host the token mint implementation. No reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is evidenced. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: uncapped MINT-role holders and their administrators remain economically unbounded, while no reserve-to-supply reconciliation, independent attestation, or named prudential supervisor is evidenced. 2026-08-15 reconciliation research: Alpha Partner's official site and linked GitBook were searched for a dated reserve report, proof-of-reserves feed, or attestation reconciling USDA liabilities against reserve assets; none was published, and no named prudential supervisor was disclosed. CertiK's dated contract audit is security-only, not a reserve reconciliation.
